name: infer-conventions
title_zh: 读一遍 Laravel 代码，替你立下团队规矩
tagline_zh: 新人问「Form Request 还是内联校验」时，不用再翻聊天记录。
tagline_en: Stop answering "Form Request or inline?" ever again. It reads your actual Laravel code and distills mixed.
desc_en: Use this skill to analyze how a Laravel application is actually written and record its conventions as shared rules. Trigger when the user wants to detect, infer, document, or standardize project conventions or coding style, set up or grow `.ai/rules`, resolve mixed or conflicting patterns (e.g. \"are we using Form Requests or inline validation?\"), or onboard agents and teammates to \"how we do th
why_zh: 不是问你要规范，而是从现有代码里反推事实。能识别冲突写法并给出裁决建议，让规则长在代码上。
why_en: It infers conventions from real code instead of asking you to write them. Spots conflicting patterns and proposes rulings, so.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel/PHP 项目；不会生成或修改代码，只产出 .ai/rules 文本。若代码里两种写法各占一半。
limit_en: Laravel/PHP only; outputs .ai/rules text, never edits code. If two patterns are 50/50, it flags the conflict but won't decide for you.
title_en: Read Laravel code once, codify team conventions
